issue.title: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "userId") in AuthService
issue.body:
## Description
After the recent refactor of AuthService, users get a 500 error when logging in with an OAuth provider. The error occurs in the token validation step.

## Stack trace
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'userId')
    at AuthService.validateOAuthToken (src/auth/auth.service.ts:87:32)
    at OAuthStrategy.validate (src/auth/oauth.strategy.ts:45:12)
```

## Steps to reproduce
1. Visit /auth/google
2. Complete Google OAuth flow
3. Observe 500 Internal Server Error

## Expected
Successful redirect to /dashboard
